siblings.title: Auth rewrite decisions
turns: What should the refresh token lifetime be?
We settled on a refresh token TTL of 30 minutes. Shorter than that and mobile clients thrash the refresh endpoint; longer and a stolen token is useful for too long.
Argon2id, with the OWASP-recommended parameters. We rejected bcrypt because of the 72-byte input truncation.

siblings.title: Database migration plan
turns: Which Postgres version are we targeting?
Postgres 16. The connection pool max is set to 20 per instance, which is what the load test supported without queueing.
Do we need a maintenance window?
Yes, roughly 20 minutes for the final cutover.

siblings.title: Checkout outage postmortem
turns: A missing index on orders.customer_id. Once the table passed about 4 million rows the lookup went sequential and checkout timed out. Total outage was 47 minutes.
Adding the index. It took 90 seconds to build.
